verdict.rationale: The only recurring automation in the evidence is portfolio-wide auto-renewal, which can be set via the API and MCP. Signed webhooks for upcoming expirations and renewals can trigger external workflows, but the evidence shows no general scheduler for user-defined recurring jobs. Missing for 10: user-defined scheduled or cron-style jobs, recurring workflow definitions (e.g., scheduled DNS changes or deploys), documentation of scheduling controls, independent corroboration.
